package com.acme.shipping.label;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;

class LabelServiceTest {

    private LabelService service;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        TrackingNumber.resetSequenceForTests();
        service = new LabelService(Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-28T01:00:00Z"), ZoneId.of("Asia/Singapore")));
    }

    @Test
    void createsLabelWithUppercasedRecipientAndTracking() {
        Label label = service.create(parcel(1200, false, null));

        assertThat(label.tracking().value()).isEqualTo("AP-20261028-000001");
        assertThat(label.lines()).containsExactly("TAN AH KOW", "Blk 123 Ang Mo Kio Ave 3", "#05-67", "560123 SG");
    }

    @Test
    void dangerousGoodsAreMarked() {
        Label label = service.create(parcel(800, true, "UN3481"));

        assertThat(label.lines()).contains("DG: UN3481", "HANDLE WITH CARE");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(ints = {0, -1, 30_001})
    void rejectsInvalidWeights(final int grams) {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.create(parcel(grams, false, null)))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void maximumWeightIsAccepted() {
        assertThat(service.create(parcel(30_000, false, null)).weightGrams()).isEqualTo(30_000);
    }

    @Test
    void zplContainsBarcodeAndEscapedText() {
        Label label = service.create(parcel(1200, false, null));

        String zpl = service.zpl(label);

        assertThat(zpl).startsWith("^XA").endsWith("^XZ").contains("^FDAP-20261028-000001^FS");
    }

    private static Shipment parcel(final int grams, final boolean dg, final String un) {
        return new Shipment(Carrier.ACME_POST, "Tan Ah Kow", List.of("Blk 123 Ang Mo Kio Ave 3", "#05-67"),
                "560123", "SG", grams, 30, 20, 10, dg, un);
    }
}
